A copy of the term shown, from the date given, to change and publish. The published term stays as it is until then.
An ended component is kept with its terms and offered for no new structure. A structure still using it is ended there first.

A formula uses numbers, its declared inputs and the codes of other components of the employer; + - * / and parentheses; the comparisons < <= > >= == != with and, or and not; and the functions if(condition, then, else), min, max, abs, round(x, places), floor(x, places) and ceil(x, places). Nothing else is accepted, and nothing is assumed: an input without a value is an error, never a default.
